bias_targets.methodology: The paper surveys various methodologies from the literature, including evaluating performance disparities in voice and face recognition, analyzing stereotype associations in word and sentence embeddings, and measuring disparities in co-reference resolution, machine translation, and job recommendation systems.

The paper surveys methods used in prior studies, such as analyzing risk score disparities in recidivism prediction tools, evaluating error rates in face recognition systems for darker skin tones, and measuring the generation of offensive text toward specific demographic groups in dialogue models.
The paper reviews studies evaluating fairness in graph-structured data by measuring the correlation between learned node representations and protected attributes such as age.
